en_hint_1_choochoo-birthday-cake_fox-lis.text: It is a piece of paper that tells you what to buy.

en_hint_1_choochoo-birthday-cake_milk-an.text: One friend used milk, and the other used a spoon.

It is a small red fruit.

en_hint_1_choochoo-birthday-cake_yanli-p.text: It is the song we sing with a birthday cake.

en_hint_1_choochoo-birthday-cake_your-bi.text: Tell me anything yummy you like on a cake!

en_hint_1_choochoo-farm-duckling_dog-sme.text: It is on your face, and you smell with it.

en_hint_1_choochoo-farm-duckling_duck-so.text: It is the sound a duck makes: quack!

en_hint_1_choochoo-farm-duckling_farm-he.text: Say the name of the animal friend you want to help.

en_hint_1_choochoo-farm-duckling_foal-ye.text: It is the color of a little duckling.

en_hint_1_choochoo-farm-duckling_help-ga.text: First they picked her up, then they took her somewhere warm.

en_hint_1_choochoo-farm-duckling_hen-foo.text: They are little marks your feet leave in the mud.

en_hint_1_choochoo-farm-duckling_your-an.text: Any animal you like! Tell me its name and make its sound.

en_hint_1_choochoo-noodle-shop_bengbeng-.text: She said two things: a polite word, and how the food tasted.

en_hint_1_choochoo-noodle-shop_blow-on-i.text: Puff up your cheeks and blow gently.

en_hint_1_choochoo-noodle-shop_count-dum.text: Count with me: one, two,  and one more!

en_hint_1_choochoo-noodle-shop_long-nood.text: Like a jump rope. Is that long or short?

en_hint_1_choochoo-noodle-shop_pick-dish.text: Say noodles (miàn tiáo) or dumplings (jiǎo zi).

en_hint_1_choochoo-noodle-shop_your-favo.text: Anything yummy! Tell me your favorite food.

en_hint_1_henny-penny_penny-acorn.text: It is a little nut that grows on an oak tree.

en_hint_1_henny-penny_penny-fox.text: Foxy Woxy has brought them to his own den.

en_hint_1_henny-penny_penny-friends.text: They have not checked what fell. What could help them find out?

en_hint_1_henny-penny_penny-home.text: They did not enter the den or visit the King. They went back where they lived.

en_hint_1_henny-penny_penny-king.text: They are on their way to someone who lives in a palace.

en_hint_1_henny-penny_penny-stop.text: It was their friend Goosey Poosey, the goose.

en_hint_1_little-red-hen_red-hen-bread.text: Think of the loaf she is baking.

en_hint_1_little-red-hen_red-hen-finish.text: She has chicks to care for and bread to make. What could you help with?

en_hint_1_little-red-hen_red-hen-flour.text: It is the soft powder used to make bread.

en_hint_1_little-red-hen_red-hen-harvest.text: The same hen who planted the seed did this job herself.

en_hint_1_little-red-hen_red-hen-seed.text: It can grow into wheat, which becomes flour for bread.
